goal: Admin tạo/sửa được instruction của từng task type (kể cả task type đã runtime-locked); pte-app hiển thị instruction từ BE, fallback về text cứng.

global_context.framework: Java 21/Spring modular monolith + Flyway; Next.js vendor-web (pnpm/turbo); Flutter/BLoC
global_context.architecture: Instruction stored on question_types, resolved live at delivery through ExamItemRuntimeResolver
constraints: Follow each repo's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and coding standards; preserve unrelated worktree changes.
Blocker before phase 1: duplicate Flyway V9 in pte-api after merging dev must be resolved.
Instruction is display metadata: editable regardless of runtime lock; plain text, max 500 chars.
Live resolution (not frozen per exam version) so edits apply to existing exams; the attempt cache keeps it stable per attempt.
pte-app keeps TaskTypeMeta.instruction as the fallback for null or blank API values.
Per-question instruction overrides are out of scope.

phases.name: api-instruction-storage
phases.description: API: column, entity, create/update DTOs, response

phases.name: api-instruction-delivery
phases.description: API: deliver live instruction on attempt task and host preview items

phases.name: web-admin-instruction-field
phases.description: Web: instruction textarea in the task-type create/edit modal

phases.name: app-instruction-from-api
phases.description: App: read instruction from API with TaskTypeMeta fallback

phases.name: verification-and-handoff
phases.description: Cross-repo tests, migration check and manual E2E
